rationale: The distribution thesis remains intact — price is still ~3.6% below session VWAP, every bounce high since entry ($41.01 → $40.90 → $40.77) has been sold, and the risk-off tape (SPY -0.72%, VIXY +2.54%) plus the unfilled gap at $38.89 keeps downside follow-through in play if $40.13 breaks. The basing above $40.45 with price hugging the 9-EMA is normal squeeze behavior near session lows that the original entry explicitly anticipated, and the defined stop at $41.38 caps risk at ~$90, well inside the remaining $161 loss budget. Flipping long would be a counter-trend trade against the dominant session structure with a wide 39 bps spread, and closing near breakeven discards a still-valid asymmetric setup.
